keyboardHelp.text:
[ / ]: Cycle marks
Arrows: Move
Shift+arrows: Resize
Ctrl+arrows: Move 10 px
Ctrl+Shift+arrows: Resize 10 px
Tab: Focus properties
Delete: Remove mark
Escape: Deselect
Insert: Place mark
Shift+drag: Square, circle, 45° line
Ctrl+Z: Undo
Ctrl+Shift+Z: Redo
Ctrl+Shift+C: Copy image

view.selection: Pen stroke 2 of 2 selected, x 190, y 515, 317 × 50 px. Arrow keys move it, Shift+arrow keys resize it, Delete removes it, [ and ] cycle marks, Tab leaves the canvas for properties, Escape deselects. Alt+arrow keys pan the image; Alt+Shift+arrow keys pan farther.
